T_BC._doc: camera pose in base_footprint: URDF position, tilted down by pitch_deg as built into the MJCF camera rgb (calibrate_camera.py --pitch-deg)

ekf_noise._doc: EKF marker noise of this camera, fitted by evaluation/consistency_sweep.py on 40 recorded runs of config/arena_lab.json against the truth: range bias 4.50 mm * r^2; residual range sd 0.00 mm + 2.55 mm * r^2 plus 4.1 mm left by the bias model; bearing sd 0.0132 deg. Errors repeat over tau = 4.9 frames (range) and 18.6 frames (bearing), so the variances are multiplied by tau (sd by sqrt(tau)).
